name: @ortho-earth/japan
description: Serverless, dependency-free 3D globe of Japan for any web page — GSI vector tiles and MLIT PLATEAU buildings drawn on a true sphere with WebGPU/WebGL2. No API keys, no billing, no servers.
author: Kenji Yoshida <kenji.yoshida.home.2026@gmail.com>

scripts.test: node demo/samples/test-scene-adapter.mjs && node tests/t-dtm.mjs && node tests/t-vocab.mjs && node tests/t-region.mjs && node tests/t-tier.mjs
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:lib && vite build && cp -R dist/lib dist/site/japan/lib && find dist/site/japan/lib -name '*.map' -delete
scripts.verify:editor: node scripts/verify-editor.mjs && node scripts/verify-editor.mjs t-backfill && node scripts/verify-editor.mjs t-zoomfill && node scripts/verify-editor.mjs "t-rectlook?tool=circle&v=%235/9/-175&a=-178,9&b=-170,9&zs=7,6,5,4,3" && node scripts/verify-editor.mjs "t-rectlook?tool=circle&v=%235/9/-175&a=-178,9&b=-162,9&zs=6&probe=450,325&far=2,-9,3" && node scripts/verify-editor.mjs t-import
scripts.deploy: npm run verify:editor && npm run verify:prod && rm -rf dist/site/japan/moj-local dist/site/japan/plateau-names.json && find dist/site -name .DS_Store -delete && wrangler deploy && node scripts/verify-live.mjs
scripts.preview:prod: npm run build:prod && rm -rf dist/site/japan/moj-local && wrangler dev
scripts.build:lib: vite build --config vite.lib.config.js && cp sdk/ortho-japan.d.ts dist/lib/
